name: Soc Framework Abnormal Security
description: Enhancements for Abnormal Security Email Protection telemetry used by the SOC Framework on Cortex XSIAM. Reshapes events from `abnormal_security_email_protection_raw` into properly-shaped XSIAM alerts with DS:Abnormal Security/Email Protection tags so Foundation Product Classification routes them into the Email category.
author: Palo Alto Networks
